original_requirement: Bound complete AI tool replies with explicit coverage and exact recovery, preserving applicable authored guidance across planning/retrieval.
observed_missing_behavior: get_concept_footprint currently accepts only project_id/concept/max_per_group and returns unbudgeted Markdown. Per-group caps cannot bound the complete reply or recover its exact original, and the standalone footprint does not include authored guidance for its returned paths.
acceptance: Public max_tokens budgets the complete reply at four UTF-8 bytes per estimated token, default40KiB. Optional JSON exposes the existing footprint_markdown, returned source paths/completeness and authored policy as named fields; it does not invent a new typed graph algorithm.

Use the existing immutable snapshot mechanism for exact original UTF-8 recovery in JSON/Markdown. Each continuation carries the budget and bypasses project/runtime/graph retrieval; invalid controls and minimum metadata refusal create no snapshot.

Keep all existing graph/lexical/literal/group caps and completeness disclosures. Guide scope follows returned footprint paths, with source-cap omissions, live instruction refresh and linked-reference disclosures; summaries require full recovery before acting.

Keep internal change-set and implementation-brief composition on the original unbudgeted FootprintEvidence path so this public delivery change cannot substitute a deferred envelope for their evidence.

Focused known-input native recovery checks and candidate/installed MCP calls in the combined three-component batch preserve original evidence, source paths and guidance after policy edits. Use owned current OciusX VB/TS copies; no production global query or Site/Q reads.
limits: Exact recovery covers the selected capped footprint, not every repository touchpoint or proven source/runtime binding.
Internal retrieval/ranking and graph algorithms are unchanged. No CodeMap/Blast work, target-language expansion or per-component build.
queued_native_cases: Exact original JSON/Markdown recovery with capped footprint qualifications, source identities and authored policy after policy edits
Small/default/large budgets and invalid/minimum metadata controls without snapshot writes
resources: Owned baseline fixture/MCP process closed and removed. Scripts/logs/receipts retained in this case for review; no build or native run started.
